ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density dark clusters are centered at the median notch and extend laterally in linear bands. Low-intensity mottling is visible along the distal edges and fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-8 pixels; higher frequency of peaks observed on the distal margins of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary leading edges; trailing edges display an irregular concave sweep from the median notch toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized roughly circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters identified near the distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct sets of parallel, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial and interior sections of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear pigmentation disruptions (scars) across the ventral surface; irregular, jagged contouring at the terminal ends of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct set of three parallel dark linear bands located in the center-left lobe area, oriented diagonally.
